extDesc.message: Automatic dark mode for every website. Sun-based scheduling, brightness and color temperature, per-site rules.

cmdToggleSite.message: Add or remove the current site from the always-day list

popupSiteHint.description: Site row hint: this URL always follows the selected mode below

popupDisabled.message: Night mode is off globally: pages won't darken, and the mode / site switches are inactive until you enable it in Settings.

optModeDisabled.message: The master switch is off — enable it above before picking a mode.
optModeDisabled.description: Mode segment disabled while master switch is off

popupUnsupported.message: Due to browser security restrictions, the extension can't run on this page (e.g. browser settings, Web Store, PDF viewer).

popupLearnMore.description: Button that opens the settings page for details

hintOtherLimits.message: For security reasons, the browser blocks extensions from injecting scripts into: internal pages (chrome://, edge://), the Web Store, PDF viewers, and other extensions' pages. Night mode can't apply there — this is a browser limitation, not a bug.
hintOtherLimits.description: Other tab: which pages are restricted

hintOtherFile.message: For local files (file://), enable "Allow access to file URLs" on the extension details page first.

hintOtherNormal.message: Regular websites are not affected. If a page doesn't darken as expected, check the site tri-state in the popup or the lists in Settings.
hintOtherNormal.description: Other tab: normal pages and troubleshooting

hintEnabled.message: Turn this off to see every site in its original colors.

hintAuto.message: Auto switches between day and night using the schedule below. Picking Night or Day manually is a temporary override that reverts to Auto at the next switch.

hintLatLng.message: Decimal degrees. North and East are positive, South and West negative. Example: 31.2304, 121.4737

detectFail.message: Could not get your location. Enter it manually.

msgReload.message: The extension was updated. Close and reopen this page.

cityFar.message: $CITY$ (~$KM$) — no city on file nearby, please check the coordinates

cityKnown.description: Fallback when the city dataset is unavailable

hintOffset.message: Negative values switch earlier. For example -30 starts night 30 minutes before sunset.

hintPolar.message: Your latitude has no sunrise or sunset today. Night Owl is using the fixed hours instead.

hintInvert.message: How dark the night is. 100 is a pure black background with white text; lower values are softer and greyer.

hintBrightness.message: Overall lightness. Above 100 is brighter, below 100 is darker — a fine tune on top of the night effect.

hintContrast.message: Contrast between text and background. Higher makes text crisper; lower is softer and flatter.

hintSaturation.message: How vivid colors are. 0 is fully grayscale, 100 is original, above 100 is more vivid.

hintWarmth.message: Tint the page warm (yellow) or cool (blue). Note: it only shifts colored elements slightly; white text and gray backgrounds stay mostly unchanged.

hintGrayscale.message: Turn the page black-and-white. Night mode is already near-grayscale, so this adds little; 100 is fully grayscale.

btnResetMediaDim.description: Button: reset media brightness to default

previewBody.message: Body text sits on a light card so you can judge contrast before saving.

lblAlwaysDarkBox.message: Always night — these sites go dark

lblAlwaysLightBox.message: Always day — these sites stay as they are

hintAlwaysDark.message: Sites here always use dark mode, even in daytime hours.

hintAlwaysLight.message: Sites here always keep their original colors. This outranks the always-night list.

btnAddSite.description: Add button next to the current site

btnAddLight.description: Add the current site to the always-day list

btnAddDark.description: Add the current site to the always-night list

hintRules.message: example.com matches exactly. *.example.com also matches subdomains. https://example.com/mail matches a path.

lblPreserveMedia.message: Keep photos and videos in original colors

hintPreserveMedia.message: Images, videos and canvas are restored to their daytime colors (only slightly dimmed) and are unaffected by temperature, grayscale, brightness or contrast. Turn off if a site renders its UI inside a canvas.

hintMediaDim.message: In dark mode, images and videos keep their daytime colors, dimmed overall to this level; 100% matches daytime. Only applies while "Keep photos and videos in original colors" above is on, and is included in config export / import.

lblSkipDark.message: Skip sites that are already dark

hintSkipDark.message: Detects the page background and leaves dark sites untouched.

hintTarget.message: Body only can fix sticky headers on some sites, but leaves the page background light.

hintBackup.message: Settings are saved as a JSON file you can copy to another computer or browser profile.

msgImportError.message: That file could not be read as Night Owl settings.

msgRestoreConfirm.message: Reset every setting back to the default?

optFooter.message: Everything runs locally in your browser. No account, no server, no data leaves this device.

msgNoBackground.message: Cannot reach the extension background. Reload the extension on chrome://extensions, then reopen this panel.
msgNoBackground.description: Background service worker did not answer
